system.description:
You infuse lightning natured chakra into the metallic object until electricity radiates off of it, sending sparks and jolts in random directions, up to 60 feet away. Electronic tools and appliances begin to overload and short-circuit if they are within 250 feet of you when you cast this jutsu.

You create a circular barrel of Lightning release chakra to stabilize the metallic object as you fire it like a railgun causing unrivaled destruction to anything in its path.

All Creatures, objects and structures in a 15-foot wide, 500-foot line must make a Dexterity saving throw. A Shocked creature makes their saving throw at disadvantage.

On a failed a creature takes 9d10 lightning damage, is knocked Prone, becomes Dazed, and gains 2 ranks of Shaken. Objects and structures take the maximum possible damage.

On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and is instead only knocked Prone and gains 2 ranks of Shaken.

Overcharge. This jutsu ignores cover and creatures cannot make their saving throws with advantage.
